definitions.explanation: The outermost or topmost layer of something physical, such as the earth's surface, skin, or a body of water.
The outward or shallow aspect of something, as opposed to its deeper, underlying reality. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表層|ひょうそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: The surface layer of the ocean is warm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地盤|じばん}→地盤：04035_jiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表層|ひょうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To survey the surface layer of the ground.

examples.japanese: {表層|ひょうそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{岩盤|がんばん}→岩盤：22242_ganban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: When the surface layer of soil was removed, bedrock appeared.

examples.japanese: {表層|ひょうそう}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ていて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧だ。
examples.english: You can't just look at the surface.

examples.japanese: {表層的|ひょうそうてき}な⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とどまって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The understanding remains only at a superficial level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表層|ひょうそう}⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{根本|こんぽん}→根本：13107_konpon⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さぐ}る→探る：03923_saguru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to look beyond the surface of the problem and investigate the root cause.

notes:
Describes the outermost layer of something, used both literally (geology, oceanography, skin) and figuratively (shallow understanding, surface-level analysis). Contrasts with ⟦{深層|しんそう}→深層：13481_shinsou⟧ (deep layer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表層|ひょうそう}{水|すい}: surface water
- {表層|ひょうそう}⟦{地盤|じばん}→地盤：04035_jiban⟧: surface ground
- {表層的|ひょうそうてき}: superficial
- {表層|ひょうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧: to dig the surface layer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {表層|ひょうそう} (surface) ↔ ⟦{深層|しんそう}→深層：13481_shinsou⟧ (deep layer) — this pair is used extensively in both literal (geology, oceanography) and figurative (psychology, analysis) contexts

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (surface, outside) + ⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧ (layer, stratum).
